summary: Iter-1 cold codegen for sranger from canonical inputs (system_description.txt, requirement_all.json, CLAUDE.md, codegen prompt files). 8 Java files + result_codegen.json. All 22 requirements implemented; 4 design choices to review.

issues.title: Terminal mode named Stopped instead of Final, with a Tick self-loop
issues.detail: SR-DM1/SR-FR3 name the terminal mode 'Final'. CLAUDE.md mandates that the theory-generated controller must NOT contain a Final state (the Isabelle deadlock_free closer hangs on it). Encoding: third mode 'Stopped', behaviourally terminal (only outgoing transition is a Tick self-loop, which also provides the bare-precondition cover CLAUDE.md prefers as pattern (b)). Entry action move(0,0) preserved.

issues.title: Move(lv, av) output encoded as multi-arg Actuator.move call, not an OutputEvent record
issues.detail: RoboChart events carry a single payload; the ETL's designed mapping for two-payload commands is a multi-arg method call extracted as an LOperations operation call. Actuator.move(lv, av) is therefore the Move output channel (SR-DM4); no OutputEvent sealed interface exists.

issues.title: Moving->Turning conjoins the Obstacle event trigger with the obstacleDetected guard
issues.detail: SR-Beh2 makes the transition event-triggered; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected guards the same transition. Both honoured: branch condition is `event instanceof InputEvent.Obstacle && obstacleDetected`.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading default = 100.0 m
issues.detail: SR-DM5 requires 'a large default value' without specifying it; 100.0 m chosen (well above OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD 0.5 m).

issues.title: Power-up Moving entry action fired in the constructor
issues.detail: SR-FR1's entry action on initial entry to Moving is issued once in the controller constructor (constructors are not extracted into the model; the model's initial transition covers it there).

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile -> isabelle_gen) and act on visible feedback.
